response.sql: WITH per_obs AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM per_obs) SELECT SUM(p.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(p.share) AS avg_share, AVG(p.share - s.a) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM per_obs p, avg_share s WHERE p.share > s.a
